content.short: Safe Global provides cutting-edge infrastructure for multisig wallets, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Safe (formerly Gnosis Safe) is a decentralized custody protocol and collective asset management platform securing billions in digital assets. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Safe Global provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on multisig wallets. By operating on Ethereum, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the Web3 Wallets sector. Through continuous innovation, Safe Global contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
content.meta: Safe Global is redefining multisig wallets on Ethereum. Dive into detailed analytics and explore Safe Global directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
